SELECT 
    c.customer_name,
    a.address_details,
    COUNT(co.order_id) AS total_order_count
FROM Customers c
JOIN Addresses a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
LEFT JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, a.address_details
